releaseNotes:
Call Waiter button on the menu tablet: the cashier gets a popup and a voice alert for that table
Set meals split by themselves across printers (e.g. the meat on Meat Section, the cold noodle or stew on Hot & Cold), with Korean names
Menu tablet: sticky top bar with the category buttons on the item list
Voice alerts work like Bluemoon: clear English ("New order for Table 1"), normal speed, and use Google's speech engine when the tablet's own can't speak
No popup or voice alert for orders and additional orders placed by a cashier
Printer setup and print routing stay safe on the server when the app is reinstalled
Print order list button only shows when a Biller printer is set up
Removed the Android notification banner for orders (it came late or not at all); the app opens and alerts on its own instead
